title: Trump, Xi and Putin agree to talks on nuclear risks after first three-way meeting
caption:
Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin met together for the first time in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the APEC summit. In a four-point joint declaration they agreed to a dialogue on reducing nuclear risks and stopping the spread of nuclear weapons, and called for UN reform and more petroleum supply. The text sets no targets for cutting nuclear arms and does not mention the war in Ukraine.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
